title: Oven-Roasted Polish Pecan Tart
description: A buttery, chewy Polish pecan tart that roasts the nuts for extra flavor, and is a crowd-pleasing vegetarian dessert.
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, and salt.
Cut in the cold butter with a pastry blender until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Press the dough evenly into a 9-inch tart pan with a removable bottom.
Bake the crust for 12 minutes, then set aside.
While the crust bakes, whisk the blanched pecans, corn syrup, vanilla extract, and egg yolk in a bowl.
Pour the pecan filling over the baked crust and spread it evenly.
Return the tart to the oven and bake for an additional 15 minutes until the filling is set.
Allow the tart to cool, sprinkle with powdered sugar, slice, and serve.
